thread:
jamie: Quick proposal 12-seat Demo Labs pilot to trial 2 prompt-template strategies + starter-credit sizing. Objective: boost day-7 active users by ~15% and capture CPL. Thoughts? :seedling:

maya: Love the pilot. Suggest 120 seats (12 groups of 10) so we can stagger onboarding waves. 40 credits each to encourage exploration but preserve budget. Route repeat requesters to an office-hours slot.

aj: Routing plan: tag all signups with utm=demo_quickstart. If user >3 API calls in 48h mark as "engaged" and send to office-hours invite. Will implement tag + funnel events. Quick: do we want an in-app nudge after first success?

jamie: Yes. Nudge after first positive eval: offer a "next step" template pack and a CTA to join lab office hours. Define "first success" as any completion > 15 tokens and user flags it useful.

leah: Office hours cadence: two live events in week 1 (NA morning, EU afternoon). Landing + reg page live Mon. Reminder sequence: reg confirm, 48h reminder, 1h reminder. Post-lab follow-up with 'bonus' 20 credits expiring in 5 days.

nate: Creative: 15s clip + single-panel hero with two CTAs: "Join Demo Labs" / "Claim Credits". Messaging angle: "Build something useful in minutes" with mini-benchmark: time-to-first-success and activation lift.

samir: Infra constraints: cap dedicated pool to 18 GPUs during peak. Add automatic fallback to a quantized variant at 75% utilization. Enable prefix caching for starter templates to save tokens and reduce tail latency. Pre-warm pools 20min before each office-hour.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Autoscaling policy set for project/demo-quickstart (min=1, max=18). Alert rule: p95 latency > 550ms -> page oncall.

maya: Experiment arms: A = "Guided starter pack" (5 curated templates + inline tips), B = "Open playbook" (10 editable examples). Both get 40 credits. We should randomize by U/S cookie.

aj: Analytics spec:
```json
{
  "experiment": "quickstart_demo_v1",
  "n": 120,
  "arms": {"A": "guided_starter","B": "open_playbook"},
  "credits": 40,
  "routing_tag": "utm_demo_qs",
  "engaged_threshold": 3,
  "metrics": ["day1_activation","day7_active","cpl","webinar_conversion"]
}
```

jamie: Nice. Need a lightweight dashboard: day1/day7 activation, CPL, webinar signups, delta A/B. @leah can you mock widgets and share a link?

leah: Will build a demo Console dashboard with those metrics + a cohort breakdown by arm. Also drafting 3 email templates: welcome, 48h nudge, post-webinar replay + credit reminder.

nate: I'll drop hero art + clip drafts by EOD Monday. Also pre-write carousel copy for major socials.

maya: Timeline: soft-launch Mon to 120 seed users (internal + partners), public opens Tue, first office hour Wed.

samir: I'll push the pre-warm job and add warmup script to prime common KV keys. Also will configure fallback model variants and caching rules.

aj: I'll wire event tracking and routing tags. Also add a small hack to attribute office-hour attendance to initial arm.

jamie: Action items recap: @aj routing + analytics, @samir infra pre-warm + fallback + caching, @leah dashboard + email flows, @nate creative assets. Standup Friday 10:30 to review metrics and go/no-go. Thanks team! :tada:
